scope: Main-circuit pipe outer envelopes; provisional equipment ports
omissions: Heater extraction steam and cascading drains (except reheat heating return to HP4)
Cooling-water circuits, vents, drains, minimum-flow recirculation, bypasses and valves
Pipe supports, thermal-expansion flexibility, seismic/stress qualification and installation sequence
assumptions: Internal wall/insulation dimensions are geometric allowances except retained steam/feedwater headers
Module branches conservatively retain their upstream header bore; no new branch sizing asserted
Below-floor condensate suction channel requires civil design, hotwell/nozzle elevations and NPSH verification
Equipment endpoint contacts are allowed only in a local nozzle region
Geometry does not revise the closed-cycle pressure budget or prove hydraulic performance

stage_connection_checks: HP exhaust connects to reheater cold side
Reheater hot side returns to IP
All three LP crossover sources are on IP; no HP-to-LP crossover
verification.method: Rendered polyline capsules; box samples <=0.15 m inflated by 0.075 m; local equipment nozzle contacts exempt
limitations: Explicit same-network junction neighborhoods exempt; no valve/fitting bodies modeled
Existing feedwater interface has 4.70 m underside clearance within provisional 5 m cross-aisle reservation
Crossover underside is 20.275 m: overhead turbine-maintenance/crane paths need separate review
